metaDescription: Manage your subscription, choose a plan, and pay from your Rawafid wallet balance.

hero.title: Billing & subscription
hero.description: Your current plan, renewal settings, and available upgrades — paid from your wallet balance.

plan.priceHint: Price locked in at subscription time
plan.freeHint: Free plan with no end date

wallet.title: Wallet balance
wallet.description: Plans are paid from your prepaid wallet balance.
wallet.insufficientHint: Not enough balance — contact Rawafid support to add funds.

plans.sectionDescription: Pick a shipment volume and billing cycle. Payment is taken from your wallet when you confirm.
plans.customPricingHint: Custom pricing — reach out to discuss options.
plans.ownerOnlyHint: Only the account owner can subscribe or change plans.
plans.staffHint: You can view billing details. Plan changes require the account owner.

checkout.title: Confirm subscription
checkout.description: You will be charged {{amount}} from your wallet.
checkout.descriptionFree: You will move to the free plan at no charge.
checkout.forfeitureWarning: Your current period ends now and is not refunded. You will be charged {{amount}} for a new {{period}}.
checkout.supportNote: To add balance to your wallet, contact Rawafid support.

errors.alreadyOnPlan: You are already on this plan.
errors.changeInProgress: Another change was in progress. Please try again.
errors.insufficientBalance: Insufficient wallet balance. Contact Rawafid support to add funds.
errors.invalidTier: This plan does not include that shipment volume.
errors.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change the subscription.
errors.generic: Could not update subscription. Please try again.

grace.title: Renewal could not be completed
grace.description: We could not renew your {{planName}} subscription. The renewal costs {{price}} and we were unable to take it from your wallet.
grace.deadline: Your plan stays active until {{date}}. We try again each day until then. If renewal has not gone through by that date, your account moves to the Free plan.
grace.ownerEmailNote: The account owner has been emailed about this. If you are not the owner, you may not have received it.
grace.contactSupport: Contact Rawafid support to add wallet balance.

autoRenew.title: Automatic renewal
autoRenew.description: When enabled, your plan renews from your wallet at the end of each period.
autoRenew.ownerOnlyHint: Only the account owner can change renewal settings.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change renewal settings.
errors.generic: Could not update renewal setting. Please try again.

cancel.title: Turn off automatic renewal?
cancel.description: Your plan stays active until {{date}}, then your account returns to the free plan. You will not be charged again.

upgrade.title: Need a custom plan?
upgrade.description: For custom pricing or help choosing a tier, our team is here to help.
upgrade.freeDescription: Not sure which plan fits? We can help you pick the right shipment volume.
benefits: Pick a shipment volume that matches your store
Monthly or yearly billing to suit your needs
Direct support from the Rawafid team

Hi Rawafid team,

notice.title: Snapshot of your current deal
notice.description: The prices and limits shown here reflect what was agreed when your subscription was activated. If platform plan pricing changes later, your details stay the same until your subscription is updated.

errors.loadFailedHint: Check your connection and try again.
